feeds.attribution: Dirección General de Tráfico (DGT), CC BY

api_key.title: Windy Webcams API Key
api_key.description: Get a free key at https://api.windy.com/keys

setup.urlLabel: Get a Windy Webcams API key
steps: Sign in to (or create) a free Windy account, then open api.windy.com/keys.
Create a new API key and select the Webcams API; the free tier requires no payment.
Copy the key (it may take a few minutes to propagate); it is sent as the 'x-windy-api-key' header.
setup.notes: Free tier returns only low-resolution images, image URLs expire after 10 minutes, and the listing offset is capped (~1000).

terms.note: Proprietary API terms: no redistribution of the API's data to any third party, no publishing of graphics showing the webcam images, images used only through the URLs the API gives and each linked to its Windy webcam page or player, and the courtesy line "Webcams provided by windy.com". Free-tier image URLs expire after 10 minutes. Served in the operator's scope only, as the operator's own application.

api_key.title: NPS API Key
api_key.description: Get a free key at https://developer.nps.gov/signup/

steps: Open nps.gov/subjects/developer/get-started.htm and fill out the 'Get Started' sign-up form.
Submit the form; an email with your personalized 40-character API key is sent to you.
Copy the key; it is sent on each request in the X-Api-Key header.
setup.notes: Self-service form on nps.gov; the key arrives by email (developer portal is developer.nps.gov). Delivery is usually near-instant.

api_key.title: Georgia 511 API Key

steps: Create a free My511 account at 511ga.org/my511/register (or log in).
Open the Developer Resources page (Developers → Documentation) at 511ga.org/developers/doc.

feeds.name: ODOT TripCheck cameras (Oregon)

api_key.title: ODOT TripCheck API subscription key
api_key.description: The primary key of a subscription to the TripCheck Data product, sent as the 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key' header.

steps: Sign up for an account on the ODOT API portal (apiportal.odot.state.or.us) and sign in.
Open Products → TripCheck Data and subscribe; read the Terms of Use with the 'Show' button and confirm them with 'I agree'.
Open your profile and copy the subscription's primary key.
setup.notes: Self-service, no approval step. Republishers credit the agency that provides each camera, mirror the data rather than hotlink it, and repeat ODOT's disclaimer.

feeds.attribution: Oregon Department of Transportation (TripCheck) and the providing agencies

terms.note: ODOT and the partner agencies allow the public and private business to use and circulate the data and camera images on three conditions: republishers credit the public agency providing the data (on many stills the agency is embedded in the image); they mirror the data on their own server rather than hotlink it, so the stills reach users only through the consumer's image proxy; and they repeat ODOT's disclaimer of warranty when acknowledging the data.

api_key.title: Transport for NSW Open Data API key (Australia)
api_key.description: An Open Data Hub API token, sent as the 'apikey' authorization header. Serves the Live Traffic hazards, the Park&Ride car parks and the Live Traffic cameras.

steps: Register for a free account at opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au and log in to the Open Data Hub.
Click your profile icon, choose 'API Tokens', enter a name, click 'CREATE API TOKEN' and copy the key (shown only once).
In the data catalogue, open the 'Car park API' and 'Live Traffic Cameras API' datasets and subscribe each to your application; the token alone authorises the live-hazard endpoints.
Paste the generated token here (sent as the 'apikey' authorization header).
setup.notes: CC-BY-4.0; attribution "Transport for NSW". One token for the hazards, car-park and camera feeds.

api_key.title: Ontario 511 developer key (Canada)
api_key.description: Sent as the 'key' query parameter. Serves the Ontario 511 events, construction projects, road conditions and cameras feeds.

steps: Create a free account at 511on.ca/my511/register (or log in); an account is needed before a key can be requested.

Request a Developer API key from the developer resources page. The request names your organisation and primary contact, describes the proposed service, and identifies every third party that will receive, redistribute or display Ontario 511 data through it (for an OpenMapX instance: OpenMapX, and federation peers if federation is on).
The Ministry reviews requests case by case; once granted, copy the key (sent as the 'key' query parameter).
setup.notes: Developer's Access Agreement: https://511on.ca/developers/resources. Data under the Open Government Licence – Ontario; the disclaimer travels with the data when it is distributed. Ontario 511 allows ten calls every 60 seconds per key. Each of the four feeds paces itself to that limit on its own, not together; their cadences (five minutes for the events, construction projects and road conditions, an hour for the cameras) keep the four well inside ten calls a minute.

url.title: Overpass URL
url.description: Base URL of the Overpass instance (http://overpass:80, https://overpass-api.de) or its full interpreter URL (http://overpass:80/api/interpreter), as OpenMapX's OVERPASS_URL accepts: queries go to the base URL plus /api/interpreter. Defaults to the public instance, which allows about 10,000 requests a day; point it at a self-hosted Overpass for heavier use. A private host also needs OPENCONDITIONS_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

api_key.title: Trafikverket key (Sweden)
api_key.description: Authentication key: sent as ?authenticationkey= to the DATEX II situation feed and in the POST request body to the traffic-flow feed.

steps: Sign up at data.trafikverket.se/oauth2/Account/register.
Create an authentication key under data.trafikverket.se/mypage/systems (My systems).
setup.notes: CC0 — no restrictions. API endpoint: api.trafikinfo.trafikverket.se/v2/data.json (the bare host has no web page).

setup.urlLabel: Register for a TDX platform account
steps: Go to tdx.transportdata.tw/register and create a free platform member account.
Sign in, open Member Center → 資料服務 → 服務金鑰 (API Key).
Create a Client Id / Client Secret pair (up to 3 per account).
Copy both values — the Client Secret is only shown once.
setup.notes: Used to obtain an OAuth2 client-credentials bearer token from tdx.transportdata.tw for the EV charging Station, ChargingRate and ConnectorLiveStatus APIs and the road CCTV lists. The free tier's quota (about 4,500 calls a month at 5 a minute) is the account's, shared by both feeds.

client_secret.title: TDX client secret
client_secret.description: The secret of the same Client Id / Client Secret pair.
